items.title: Enforce document import-edge property in index builder
items.why_now: Unblocks churn.py which relies on documents having no import edges; without explicit enforcement, the assumption may break silently.

steps.do: Add a check in structcore/index.py that sets import_edges to empty for documents and logs a warning if any import edges are found for a document node.

items.assumption: The function build_index in structcore/index.py is the correct location; the exact line numbers are unknown.

items.title: Fix undefined variables in report.py
items.why_now: Potential NameError in report.py if units, renamed, near, windows, fenced are not defined; this would crash the structure_summary function.

steps.do: Inspect daedalus/structcore/report.py to locate the usage of units, renamed, near, windows, fenced around lines 130-136. If undefined, add appropriate definitions or imports.
steps.verified_by: grep -n 'units\|renamed\|near\|windows\|fenced' daedalus/structcore/report.py && python -c "from daedalus.structcore.report import *; print('ok')"

items.assumption: The variables are expected to be defined earlier in the file or imported; if they are defined conditionally or in another module, the fix may require adding imports.

items.title: Guard spectral keys in picker.py map_candidates
items.why_now: Missing spectral keys cause KeyError in callers that assume they are always present; this blocks spectral enrichment feature.

steps.do: Inspect map_candidates function in daedalus/spine/picker.py and add key presence checks or defaults for spectral fields. Update callers to handle missing keys gracefully.

items.assumption: The map_candidates function is in picker.py; the exact location is unknown. The settling check requires inspecting the function and its callers.

items.title: Add validation for missing index keys in forest.py
items.why_now: Silent omission of edges when index keys are missing can mislead downstream metrics; logging or error is needed for correctness.

steps.do: In daedalus/structcore/forest.py, add logging or validation when index.get() returns empty defaults, indicating missing keys. Optionally raise or warn.

items.assumption: The build_forest function uses index.get() with empty defaults; adding logging will not break existing behavior.
